title: The Pace of AI Progress
tagline: How far has AI come, how would you know, and what can two points tell you about next year?
hub_blurb: Draw where five widely cited AI benchmarks went, see why the tests keep being replaced, and read real achievements by who checked them.
card_blurb: Five sourced benchmark series to estimate and reveal, four benchmark families with the reasons each generation was retired, fourteen real achievements ranked by acceptance status and the AI's role, and three forecast rules that fit the same two points.
description: The Pace of AI Progress teaches careful reading of AI evidence across two measures that never share a scale. Four stages: estimate and reveal five sourced benchmark series, each point carrying its harness, effort and eval set; read four benchmark families and the four routes by which a test stops measuring what it was meant to - beaten, bad tasks, contamination, coverage; read fourteen real 2023-2026 achievements by their rung on an acceptance ladder from Nobel Prize to retracted and by how load-bearing AI actually was; then test why three rules fit the same two points. Every figure resolves to a source opened on the snapshot date, with the fetch method stated. Runs offline with Guide, Settings, presentation mode, in-place Reset, live data integrity checks, canonical presenter notes and a printable PDF.
